name: bundled-requirement-decomposition
body: `requirements.requirement.reviewer-upgrade-removal-guide` states user-facing upgrade behaviour: `APG_UPGRADE_DOC` carries the manual-removal step for a repo-local `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`, and the `upgrade_doc_covers_version_field_gate_and_fix_steps` needle covers it. The requirement is parented under `requirements.user.apg-upgrader`; the reviewer-distribution requirement `requirements.requirement.reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated` is parented under `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer`.
